name: actions
description: A collection of actions for the acorn icon repository

scripts.transform: npm run transform:icons && npm run transform:illustrations && npm run format:categories
scripts.transform:icons: cd ../.. && INPUT_FILES='icons/desktop/**/*.svg' .github/actions/node_modules/.bin/tsx .github/actions/src/desktop-transform/index.ts && INPUT_FILES='icons/mobile/**/*.svg' INPUT_FILE_TYPE=svg .github/actions/node_modules/.bin/tsx .github/actions/src/mobile-transform/index.ts && INPUT_FILES='icons/mobile/**/*.xml' INPUT_FILE_TYPE=xml .github/actions/node_modules/.bin/tsx .github/actions/src/mobile-transform/index.ts
